name: 2018-1c-parcial2-masked
title: Seabed Survey Crawler
description: A seabed survey crawler on a flat grid, with an integer position and a facing towards one of the four walls of its cell, receives a String of single-character commands (a, t, g, h) and must stop processing at the first invalid command. The student must build the model from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: The natural temptation is a case-like dispatch on the facing symbol and on the command character; the good design replaces both with polymorphic facing objects and command objects, plus stopping the command stream on the first invalid command.
